source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The checked port takes toggleAttribute's return value as the next state. Calendar view toggles assign that Boolean to rotated, workdaysOnly, tasksInView or showCompleted; modebox togglePane passes it to setVisible. The timezone test helper separately compares presence with a documented Boolean input whose callers supply true/false. These concrete consumers explain the type change from true/false strings; they do not establish a rule for all attributes or native command propagation.
title: Calendar checked toggles pass Boolean results to view state
